# v1.1.2 per-lane discontinuity metrics — golden baseline
#
# Produced by tools/render_test at commit 58cf80b (tag-equivalent v1.1.2), macOS arm64,
# Release build. These accompany v1-lane-renders.sha256: the checksums prove bit-identity,
# these numbers say *how* a render differs when it no longer matches, which is what you
# actually need while debugging a WP1/WP3 regression.
#
# Render conditions (all fixed, no RNG anywhere in the v1 signal path):
#   48000 Hz / block 512 / 120 BPM / 4 bars / hostSync OFF (internal free-run clock)
#   Test signal: 220 Hz sine, amplitude alternating 1.0 / 0.05 per quarter note
#   1.0 s pre-roll with all steps OFF, then all 16 steps ON for the soloed lane
#   Analysis window skips the pre-roll plus one further block (cold-start transient)
#
# Columns:
#   maxDelta   max adjacent-sample delta over the analysis window
#   >0.3       count of deltas above the severe-click bar (must stay 0)
#   >discont   count above 2x the clean-220Hz-sine baseline of 0.028798 (must stay 0)
#   RMS        RMS over the analysis window
#   rangeViol  capture-buffer reads outside the declared slice window (must stay 0)
#
# BASELINE UPDATE 2026-07-27: the audio path switched from StepSequencer to
# BlockSequencer. Seven of the eight lanes stayed bit-identical; only Filter's checksum
# changed, and the metrics below are unchanged for every lane including Filter.
#
# The Filter difference was measured rather than assumed: 61124 of 769024 samples differ by
# a maximum of 1 LSB in 24-bit (8388608 full scale), i.e. about -138 dBFS. That is
# floating-point rounding, not a behavioural change -- BlockSequencer derives the division
# length as a double where StepSequencer used an int, and Filter is the only lane whose LFO
# phase accumulates across that value. Verified by rendering both paths and differencing
# them sample by sample.
#
# Lane        maxDelta      >0.3   >discont         RMS   rangeViol
Stutter       0.049230         0          0    0.506871           0
TapeStop      0.001304         0          0    0.044121           0
TapeStart     0.038302         0          0    0.500717           0
Reverse       0.029698         0          0    0.504533           0
Repitch       0.021425         0          0    0.504635           0
Gate          0.031770         0          0    0.348693           0
Filter        0.032502         0          0    0.516004           0
Crush         0.028809         0          0    0.500625           0
